programmes.d: Single girl Bridget Jones decides to turn over a new page in her life, channeling her thoughts, opinions, and insecurities into a diary. It's instead a hilarious chronicle of her adventures in this modern-romance classic based on the bestseller.

programmes.t: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason
programmes.d: After six perfect weeks with boyfriend Mark Darcy, the mischievous Daniel Cleaver returns, claiming to be a reformed man. Can Bridget find a way to make true love last forever? A comedy that proves there's nothing like love to send you over the edge.

Bridget Jones is back, this time unexpectedly pregnant and unsure of the baby's father. Patrick Dempsey joins Oscar® winners Renée Zellweger and Colin Firth in this next chapter of Bridget's hysterically unpredictable life.
Multiple Academy Award winner Tom Hanks reunites with his Sleepless in Seattle co-star, Meg Ryan, and director Nora Ephron, to discover love at first byte in this online romantic comedy.

Jerry Maguire is a sports agent who reaches a crisis point in his life when he decides to become an honorable man. Follow his journey to redemption through an unlikely alliance with a female accountant, and his least important client.
